name: Perfecto Fernandez
bio: Perfecto Fernandez, described by the paper as Mexican, came to the Bad Lands with Johnny Goodall in May 1884 and impressed the town by riding a horse that had thrown several others. He was in from Beaver creek in February 1885, and in April 1886 rode Gus Grisy's sorrel to victory in a horse race.
